prompts.body: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: illustration for one of three Chinese philosophy website chapter cards. Primary request: a refined original philosophical engraving, Renaissance copperplate line work combined with Chinese literati restraint, very fine forest-green ink, subtle antique gold accents, generous negative space, landscape 3:2 composition. The illustration should occupy the central two thirds, quietly dissolve toward the background, no border, no lettering, no labels, no logos, no glowing effects, no infographic. Scene: warm ivory paper (#f4f2eb). A fully clothed barefoot human figure seen from behind, standing at a shallow stream, one hand gently touching a low branch. Water, touch and grounded feet communicate bodily experience and entering the world through a living body. Natural human proportions, elegant sparse landscape, calm and humane.
